text.tspan: VPC CNI (Container Network Interface) custom networking: where pod IPs come from, before and after
9 more pod IPs from this subnet
9 more pod IPs from this subnet
Every pod takes an IP from the SAME small subnet as its node
→ the subnet runs out: "failed to assign an IP address to container"
Node subnets are often a small /24.
Pod traffic uses the ENIConfig's security
group; the node keeps its own.
Pods use 100.64.x, which never leaves the VPC.
Short terms: ENI = Elastic Network Interface · EC2 = Elastic Compute Cloud · CIDR = Classless Inter-Domain Routing · VPC = Virtual Private Cloud
SNAT = Source Network Address Translation · RFC = Request for Comments · CNI = Container Network Interface
